data: What is the approximate range of the "learning_rate" hyperparameter for which the "objectiveValue" is between 4.1 and 4.14?

The question asks about the approximate range of the "learning_rate" hyperparameter for which the "objectiveValue" is between 4.1 and 4.14. From the caption, we know that the figure shows average per-word validation cross-entropies for hyperparameter combinations in the neighborhood of the best solution. The objectiveValue is represented on the y-axis of the leftmost graph.

Looking at the "learning_rate" graph, we can see that the red line represents the average per-word validation cross-entropy. The "learning_rate" values are shown on the x-axis of this graph. The red line intersects the y-axis between approximately 4.1 and 4.14 when the "learning_rate" value is around 0.0032. Therefore, the approximate range of the "learning_rate" hyperparameter for which the "objectiveValue" is between 4.1 and 4.14 is around 0.0032.
